claim: Charged more than the booked rate

decoy_patterns.cypher: MATCH (o:`Order` {id: 'ORD-B02'})-[:GUARANTEED_WITH]->(g:Card) WHERE g.product = 'Gold' MATCH (h:Dispute {id: 'DSP-HIST-B02'}) WHERE h.outcome = 'rejected' RETURN o, g, h
decoy_patterns.name: past program booking guaranteed with a Gold Card was rightly rejected

intake: Harbor Point charged me $1,300 for a two-night stay I booked at the $1,000 Platinum Stays rate.
misleading_surface: The hotel's own folio terms say the Platinum rate needs a Platinum Card at checkout, and a similar past Dispute was rejected.

proof_patterns.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispute {id: 'DSP-2026-91002'})-[:DISPUTES]->(c:Charge)-[:FOR_ORDER]->(o:`Order`)-[:GUARANTEED_WITH]->(g:Card), (c)-[:CHARGED_TO]->(p:Card), (o)-[:UNDER_PROGRAM]->(prg:Program)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(m:Merchant)-[:BOUND_BY]->(:PolicyDocument)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(cl:Clause {id: 'CLS-AMX-PS-PART-3.4'}) WHERE g.product = 'Platinum' AND p.product = 'Gold' RETURN d, o, g, p, prg, cl
proof_patterns.name: booked with Platinum, charged to Gold, at a hotel bound by the program's no-added-conditions clause
